_doc: Scene catalog: the only scene types a storyboard may use. A storyboard picks types and fills params; the engine draws them in the channel's look. Adding a type is an engine change (see studio/sop/06-storyboard.md, 'When no scene type fits'). status: 'planned' = specified, not yet implemented in the shared engine; 'built' = implemented and has a sample render.

title_card.purpose: Big hook text with one supporting prop. The first 1-2 s of most Shorts.

params.prop: optional prop id from the channel's prop set

map_focus.purpose: Real Natural Earth map; zoom to a region, highlight it, drop pins.

map_route.purpose: Animated path or arrows across a real map (routes, invasions, migrations).

count_up.purpose: A number that counts to its value, with a unit and an optional qualifier ('the major's own count').

params.qualifier: optional string, required when the claim is an estimate

versus.purpose: Two things side by side with a verdict (organ vs organ, country vs country, army vs emus).

ranking_bars.purpose: Static ranked bars from a dataset, top N, one highlighted.

params.dataset: path to data file in the episode

ranking_race.purpose: Bar-chart race through time from a dataset.

character_dialog.purpose: Two or more cast members talking; each spoken para with a speaker animates that character.

character_explain.purpose: One cast member presents a diagram or prop.

stamp_reveal.purpose: Rubber-stamp punchline word over the previous scene (LOST, DENIED, 10x).

quote_card.purpose: A sourced quotation, typeset, with speaker and year. The voice reads it.

timeline.purpose: Horizontal timeline with dated events popping in.

diagram_callout.purpose: A drawn object with labelled callouts (a gun, a cell, a reactor).

split_compare.purpose: Before and after, or expectation and reality, in two panels.

custom.purpose: Escape hatch: a one-off scene written in code. Needs a stronger model or a human review; use sparingly (target: under 20% of runtime).

params.fn: name of a function in the episode's scenes.js
params.why: one sentence on why no catalog type fits

outro_loop.purpose: Final beat that visually matches the first frame, so the Short loops cleanly.

params.echo_of: scene id of the opening scene
